name: DeTrack
author: Dorneles
description: URL tracker cleaner and instant QR Code sharing popup for Omarchy.

barWidget.description: Strips trackers from clipboard URLs, displays scannable QR Code, with 1-click Copy and Browse actions.

schema.label: Show Trackers Removed on Bar
schema.description: Displays the number of stripped tracking parameters on the status bar icon.

schema.label: Bar Icon Style
schema.description: Icon displayed on the status bar (󰒃 Shield, 󰌹 Link, 󰐳 QR Code).

schema.label: QR Code Theme Style
schema.description: Color palette for QR Code (󰒃 Accent on White, 󰌹 Dark Themed, 󰄬 Classic Black & White).

schema.label: Auto-Clean Clipboard
schema.description: Automatically clean URLs copied anywhere on your system in the background.

schema.label: Preserve Parameters Whitelist
schema.description: List of query parameter names to never strip (e.g. specific affiliate IDs or partner tags).
